Definition: Ur, a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Haran died in Ur of the Chaldees, the land of his nativity, and among David's mighty men stands Eliphal the son of Ur. The city is where Abraham was born, and the man is known only as the father of one of David's mighty men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ur matters because it is where Abraham's story begins and where it is left behind: God called a man out of a city of moon-worship, and the leaving was the first act of faith.
